cases.name: seeds-from-a-read
cases.covers: The controller reads the Info dict once when the document connects and sets it; getSnapshot() is null until then.

cases.name: a-failed-seed-read-is-ignored
cases.covers: A read that rejects (a closed document, an aborted read) leaves the state null and reports nothing.

cases.name: live-updates-from-the-event-stream
cases.covers: A metadata.updated event, own or remote, replaces the state with the metadata it carries; any other event is ignored; closing the document unsubscribes.

cases.name: update-writes-through-and-sets
cases.covers: update(patch) sends the three-state patch to the engine and resolves with its result once the confirmed metadata.updated event has set the snapshot.

cases.name: update-refused
cases.covers: An engine refusal rejects update() with the engine error and changes nothing.

cases.name: reload
cases.covers: refresh() re-reads and sets; a failed refresh rejects.

cases.name: can-edit
cases.covers: canEdit() is the doc.metadata.modify authority, wildcard included.

cases.name: update-without-the-capability-is-refused-locally
cases.covers: Without doc.metadata.modify, update() rejects with a permission-denied PluginError before it reaches the engine, and the snapshot and status stay as they were.

cases.name: a-forbidden-seed-read
cases.covers: A seed read the engine refuses with PermissionDenied leaves the snapshot null and the status forbidden; a later plain failure makes it error, and a good refresh makes it ready.

cases.name: status-while-the-seed-read-is-in-flight
cases.covers: The status is loading while the seed read is out, and a refresh made meanwhile shares that read instead of issuing a second one.

cases.name: an-event-during-the-seed-read-wins
cases.covers: A confirmed metadata.updated that lands while the seed read is out is newer than that read, so the read is dropped when it arrives.

cases.name: closing-during-the-seed-read
cases.covers: Closing the document while its seed read is out ends that read as instance-closed, which the controller swallows: nothing is reported.

cases.name: on-updated-reports-each-confirmed-change
cases.covers: onUpdated fires once per confirmed value, after the snapshot changed: the seed read with every key and a system origin, then each event with its previous value, the keys that differ (custom by its JSON, so reordered entries count) and the origin the event carried. After unsubscribing it stays quiet.

cases.name: changed-keys-beyond-the-info-dict
cases.covers: changedKeys compares every key but custom with !==: an equal number is unchanged and a different one changed, while an object or array member always counts as changed, even with the same contents.
cases.reason: Pins changedKeys' comparison rules, through its returned value. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.
